resume: Cut-A-Dor is a beat dojo for scratch DJs and beatmakers: boom bap, lo-fi and breaks across sixteen rhythm families, an eight-lane 32-step sequencer, punch-in effects you record bar by bar onto a tape, a bass voice. The keys have three modes: DJ, DRUM and BREAK.

The kit; on Step Dojo, the step; on Parts, the part; on the MIX, the track.
A new groove (one direction) or a mutation (the other), at the next bar; on Step Dojo, redoes the track or undoes; on the MIX, undoes.
In DJ: Roll, Stutter, Reverse, Brake, Filter, Echo, Crush, Gate, Lock, New, Fill, A, B, Drop, Undo, Clean. On Step Dojo: the sixteen steps.
The first eight mute the eight tracks; the last three: Tap, Tape and Undo. On Step Dojo, 1 to 8 choose the track.

gestes: A page button held 0.7 s: its help card on screen (SELECT or PRESETS to flip through them).
